text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Run, run, run... RUN!!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(A run to repay...!! The miracle I was 
given—...!!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Yaaaaaaaargh!!

A momentary chill ran down my spine. 
...Drowning it out, cheers celebrating the 
finish line echoed all around.

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! That KS Miracle girl... Isn't she 
packing some serious speed?

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Seeing them running with all their 
might makes you just want to cheer them 
on, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Miracleee~~~!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Helios! You came?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I was watchin' with Bam-cham and 
Zeph-chi~~!! Soooo for real fast! Blazing 
fast!! Miracle, you're the beeeeeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, hey!! Spectators are not allowed on 
the track, please stay back!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOO, SO SORRY, PAL!! Helios, I'll be 
right back, okay!? Ah, Miracle, great work 
today...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I shall send a congratulatory breeze 
later... However, that was a truly 
splendid gale you whipped up, 
Miracle-san."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...! Thank you, everyone...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, I'm surprised. To think everyone 
was watching...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I was fast... huh? ...Yeah. Maybe I 
managed to do something. Even me—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text: "...Milady. So this is where you were."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text: ...Milady?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me. Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
"I am terribly sorry to interrupt. 
However, the time for your next scheduled 
appointment is fast approaching."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'll head over right away.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Let us go.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I got so many congratulatory phone calls. 
From Mom, Dad... and even the doctor who 
took care of me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It looks like they watched my debut race 
closely. ...They told me I ran admirably.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“Still. I feel like those words are far 
too generous for me right now.”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Not yetâit all starts from here.

I turn back to face the whiteboard. In 
truth—if someone pointed out that all 
she's done so far is win her Debut, they 
wouldn't be wrong.
choice_data_list: Shall we talk about our future outlook?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's do our best.

And so, I decide to start by talking with 
K.S.Miracle. What she wants to aim for, 
the direction she wants to go...
choice_data_list: Would you tell me what you're hoping for?
Will you tell me what you want?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: The "Sprint division."

First, she answered immediately without 
hesitation— and then quietly continued.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My pride lies in these legs. In this 
"speed" that everyone gave me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"So, the path that can make the most of 
that... the path of competing for the 
fastest speed, is what I want to aim for."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Compared to medium and long distances, 
it doesn't get as much attention... so, 
um, it might not add much to your track 
record as a Trainer, but..."
choice_data_list:
No, you really don't need to worry about 
that!

text_block_list.text:
I quickly denied it. In the first place, 
the path K.S.Miracle proposed was one I 
agreed with.

From my perspective as well, ever since I 
first saw her run, I felt that 
K.S.Miracle's true essence lay in her 
speed.
choice_data_list: Let's set our sights on the sprint route.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you will permit me to take that path, 
then I will aim for the highest peak of it 
all. ...I will aim for the GⅠ races.

In that split second, the gaze in 
K.S.Miracle's eyes—that vivid blue—took on 
a deep, solemn glow.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The grand festival of the fastest 
Umamusume: The "Sprinters Stakes."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So, with a victory... I'll repay them the 
best way I know how—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to fulfill it. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
With everything I have on the line, 
without fail.

Suddenly—the chill I felt during my debut 
race came rushing back into my chest.

K.S. Miracle was undeniably fast. Though 
the crowd was sparse for a debut race, 
many of them were left thoroughly 
impressed.

However, what I felt back then was, 
without a doubt, an indescribable 
'danger.'

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: —She's just "too fast."

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"You hear about it sometimes, right? That 
for some Umamusume, their bodies just 
can't keep up with the speed they can put 
out..."

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Some girls have an engine so powerful 
their bodies simply cannot handle it.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That goes double since her body was weak 
to begin with. ...And on top of that, that 
girl's drive is 'too strong.'

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Even if the strain enters the danger 
zone... she never eases off her speed.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"It's not that she 'can't stop,' it's that 
she 'won't stop.'"

Vividly resurfacing in my mind was the 
warning I once received from a colleague.

"K.S.Miracle will not stop"... I feel the 
weight of those words growing heavier with 
each passing day.

So intense it made me want to shrink back 
in fear—
choice_data_list:
...No, this is no time to be chickening 
out!

text_block_list.text:
Rousing my spirits, I looked over the 
compiled notes again. I have to tell her. 
Tomorrow... without fail.

"And the next day, after training. In the 
trainer's office, I shared the conclusion 
I had thoroughly thought through yesterday 
with K.S.Miracle."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying we should take a 
wait-and-see approach until the spring of 
the Classic year...?
choice_data_list:
Right, we're dedicating this time to 
conditioning your body.

Right, we're using this period for body 
conditioning.

text_block_list.text:
Spreading out the documents summarizing 
the training plan, I explain it. About 
making the Classic Year—that is, up until 
next spring—our preparation period.

Naturally, entering a race is an option 
once preparations are complete... but 
fundamentally, the plan is to "build your 
body up through training."
choice_data_list: I'd like to make that our immediate goal.

text_block_list.text:
Even after she finished speaking, 
K.S.Miracle remained silent for a while.

Knowing how hardworking she is, I'm sure 
she would have preferred to aim for graded 
stakes victories from the very start, but—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"You made this decision after thinking and 
thinking... so carefully about me, didn't 
you?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Understood. So for a while, it will be a 
preparation period... right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but... if you decide that I'm ready, 
please do enter me in the race.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please don't hold back on my account. I 
can run. ...I'm fine, really.

I suppose we've reached a tentative 
understanding... Our immediate plan was 
set: focus on training, and enter races 
when the timing is right.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Ah, look at the time—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ruby, what are you doing about your bath 
today? Just taking a quick shower in your 
room? I'm—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ! ...Excuse me, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, no—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Wanna hit the bath together? I really 
want to warm up today.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Ruby barely said a word. Not while taking 
a bath, nor after returning to the room.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, to me, the Ruby from back then 
was—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(It looked as though she had something to 
say the whole time, yet kept swallowing 
her words.)
